text: GATK's HaplotypeCaller performs local de novo assembly around candidate variant regions and genotypes using a PairHMM probabilistic likelihood model.
explanation: True. HaplotypeCaller reassembles the local region around candidate variants into candidate haplotypes and then computes genotype likelihoods using a PairHMM model of the probability of observing the reads given each candidate genotype, and it outputs a GVCF for later joint genotyping.
